summary: ansible-core 2.11 made list_no_log_values, list_deprecations and handle_aliases in ansible.module_utils.common.parameters private; use ArgumentSpecValidator.validate() instead.
questions: Can I still call handle_aliases from module_utils.common.parameters?

answer_card.title: parameters helpers are now private
answer_card.answer_md: `list_no_log_values`, `list_deprecations` and `handle_aliases` in `ansible.module_utils.common.parameters` are **private** now. Use **`ArgumentSpecValidator.validate()`**, whose result exposes aliases, no_log values and deprecations.
